item.text: {"search_note":"Assessment: mildly favorable, but with an evidence gap on actual military-spending choices. The 2024 record I found points more toward restraint, peacekeeping, and civilian-protection use of security forces than toward militarization for intimidation or elite enrichment. I did not find direct 2024 reporting on defense-budget manipulation, arms procurement kickbacks, or neighbor-intimidation via military mobilization. Main gap: I did not find direct 2024 reporting on defense procurement, military budgets, or elite-reward networks tied to spending.
